title: The Atria outpost, step 1 of 3: one Outpost Kit bought at Ironlight Crossroads (LHS 1140, lawless) and stored at Node Beta, six jumps from Atria on the north road
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-18 00:20 UTC, off (orders.log ENT-052, P4 (b) and block APOLLO (2): Atria is chosen for the north outpost; plan its kit and road, build it once GSC-0044 runs by routes). The kit: Ironlight Crossroads asks 148,663 cr for its one kit (book of 2026-11-18 00:13 UTC), the same ask the first kit was bought at; the limit 150,150 is that price with the buyer's 1% tax, as for the first kit (route_run.py `offer`). The way: out with an empty hold (rule F13), 6 jumps from Node Beta (Pherkad, Synchrony, Node Alpha on the way back); the kit is stored at Node Beta, from where the road to Atria runs GSC-0027, GSC-0050, Brachium, GSC-0049, Acrab, Atria (6 jumps, table lanes). Step 2 is found.py of the skill logistics-stock from Node Beta (deploy_outpost, fee 100,000 cr, the treasury first); step 3 the bunker's supply from Central Nexus cells (7 jumps) by the runner's `bunker` step. Switched on only on the Fleet Admiral's allocation of the kit's credits (no hauler holds 150,150 cr: wallets stop at 50,000 by orders D11) and her word for the founding fee (requests.log). min_credits 155,000 and max_pilots 1 keep it to the one pilot that holds the allocation.
